common_operations.anchored_singleton_A1: If q=max(0,floor(g/2)-1) is positive, Base, DirectedCutOnly and Enhanced use the same seeds, farthest cone, positive fallback, standard rows, top-two view, state accounting and ownership transfer. The A1 builder reads neither enhancement flags nor dual potentials.
common_operations.ordinary_A1_view: Every legal configuration reads the common A1 view; DirectedCut adds its independent potential to the ordinary max stack instead of replacing A1.
common_operations.witness_rent_or_buy: After preprocessing, every legal configuration creates the same scheduler at rent=0. Common A1 and ordinary D continuously pay queue-pop/edge-relax rent; each profile substitutes only its own witness vertex count into t*((3^k-1)/2+3^k), and every eligible buy invokes the same EvaluateWitnessTree.

same_role_replacements.distance_root_initialization: BootstrappedBounded -> CompletePotential; both are realizations of one BuildDistanceRootInitialization responsibility and return the same {group_distance, root, feasible upper} contract. The canonical SPT union and full-distance expansion are private representation costs inside the respective realization, not unequal outer stages.
same_role_replacements.upper_witness: Base root-path tree -> Enhanced primal upper plus dual-primal tree. Both preprocessing paths only construct their witness and never unconditionally call EvaluateWitnessTree; both then enter the common zero-rent scheduler, common buy formula and common tree DP. Common root-star and root-path-union uppers remain shared, and facility is separately classified as a safe addition.
same_role_replacements.high_completion_after_A1: Base forward high A -> Enhanced common A1/low A plus adjoint high H; with q>0, ell=max(1,floor(q/2)) keeps A1 outside the replaced suffix

relation_contract.regression_assertion: abhss_configuration_exactness checks the common A1 realization in all legal profiles, the added-operation subset relation, every remaining replacement realization, and exact one-realization coverage of every required anchored layer for group counts 0..16

contract.logical_grid: q=max(0,floor(g/2)-1) is the largest anchored-mask cardinality required by the balanced exact-completion recurrence; the required positive layers are exactly 1..q
contract.base: Base realizes the whole required grid with forward A. If A1 is a member of 1..q, the same standard row is generated before ordinary D, reused through a read-only cone-future view, and then ownership-transferred to the common forward kernel without a second closure or a second state count
contract.directed_cut_only: The directed-cut potential replaces the ordinary-future responsibility; the common full forward-A kernel realizes every required anchored layer
contract.enhanced: The directed-cut potential replaces the ordinary-future responsibility. With ell=floor(q/2), common forward A realizes 1..ell and adjoint H realizes the complementary high-layer responsibility ell+1..q
contract.forbidden_dispatch: No graph name, query identity, row density, elapsed time, measured performance, or empirical condition of the form g compared with a tuned constant selects the A1 path
contract.configuration_freeze: The enhancement mask is fixed before the query starts and cannot change during the query

contract.preprocessing: Base constructs only its root-path witness; DirectedCutOnly/Enhanced construct only their dual-primal witness for this responsibility. Neither path unconditionally calls EvaluateWitnessTree.
contract.common_start: SolveOneQuery constructs one WitnessUpperScheduler after preprocessing; rent is initialized to exactly zero in every legal profile.
contract.common_buy_formula: B_wit(T,k)=|V(T)|*((3^k-1)/2+3^k), with k=g-1; only the current profile's already-constructed witness size differs.
contract.common_rent: A1 and ordinary D use the same scheduler and continuously account actual queue pops plus inspected adjacency entries.
contract.common_tree_dp: Every eligible purchase calls the single EvaluateWitnessTree implementation. A revision guard forbids repeat evaluation on identical ordinary input.
contract.fixed_a1_cutoff: If an A1 purchase strictly improves best, the partial A1 pass is discarded and rebuilt from its first singleton mask with the new fixed cutoff. The revision guard prevents a second purchase during that restarted pass.
contract.state_accounting: Discarded partial A1 work pays rent but is not a published logical state; only the final accepted A1 rows are counted and transferred to forward A.

contract.common_entry: For every feasible query that reaches nontrivial distance preprocessing, every legal configuration calls BuildDistanceRootInitialization exactly once from PrepareProblem; zero-cost component closure returns before this responsibility is needed.
contract.common_output: Every realization returns DistanceRootInitialization{group_distance, root, upper}; upper is a feasible original-graph upper bound and every downstream consumer reads the same value/IsExact distance-oracle contract.
contract.bootstrapped_bounded: Privately attempts a canonical real-edge SPT-union cutoff, builds a bounded GroupRow oracle, and executes the common root-star scan. If canonical terminals lack a common component, the provisional cutoff is infinite, finite labels are not truncated, and the common-root scan obtains a finite upper in the already-validated feasible component.
contract.complete_potential: Builds a complete GroupRow distance oracle and executes the same root-star scan; complete distances also support the safely added directed-cut certificate.
contract.outer_control_flow: PrepareProblem no longer schedules BuildCanonicalSptUpper or any other Base-only SPT stage; SPT bootstrap and full-distance expansion are the private representation costs of two same-role realizations.
contract.non_redundancy: CompletePotential is not forced to repeat the canonical SPT bootstrap because doing so cannot change its complete distance output or common root-star result and would add up to g single-source shortest-path searches.
